image_description: A flat-lay photograph displaying four vintage comic book covers arranged in a grid. The top-left cover features an orange alien creature; the top-right shows a superhero figure in blue and red; the bottom-left depicts a green dinosaur-like monster; and the bottom-center shows two soldiers in combat gear. All covers exhibit retro art styles with bold, stylized typography that appears distorted or nonsensical upon close inspection.

artifact_observations.location: All four comic covers, specifically titles and subtitles
artifact_observations.reasoning: The text on all covers is nonsensical. Characters are malformed, mixed between Latin and pseudo-Cyrillic/glyphs, and do not form readable words. This is a hallmark AI generation artifact where the model mimics the shape of text without understanding orthography.

The shading on the alien's skin has a smeared, airbrushed quality that lacks the distinct line work or halftone patterns typically found in vintage comics. It looks more like a digital painting than a printed comic cover.

The anatomy of the soldier on the right is ambiguous. The legs and weapon seem to merge into the background foliage, and the perspective of the ground plane is inconsistent with the figures standing on it.
The four covers are arranged in a grid but do not lie perfectly flat. The shadows between them are inconsistent, suggesting some may be floating slightly or the lighting source is ambiguous.
